figures.caption: model-joint Left: Neural Forth Abstract Machine. A forth sketch $ P $ is translated to a low-level code $ P _ $, with slots \ ...\ substituted by a parametrised neural networks. Slots are learnt from input-output examples $( x , y )$ through the differentiable machine whose state $ S _ i $ comprises the low-level code, program counter $ c $, data stack $ $ (with pointer $ d $), return stack $ $ (with pointer $ r $), and the heap $ $. Right: BiLSTM trained on Word Algebra Problems. Output vectors corresponding to a representation of the entire problem, as well as context representations of numbers and the numbers themselves are fed into $ $ to solve tasks. The entire system is end-to-end differentiable. model
